items.title: Beyond tree cover: mapping the world’s forest types
items.en_title: Beyond tree cover: mapping the world’s forest types
items.en_oneliner: Google DeepMind has released a global map that sorts every 10-meter square of land on Earth into its forest type.

items.en_title: Air Governance: Manage AI Agents, Access, and Spend Throughout Your Organization
items.en_oneliner: JetBrains Air Governance is now generally available as the organization layer of JetBrains Air, managing agent access and spend.

items.title: LangSmith LLM Gateway: Runtime Controls for Agents
items.en_title: LangSmith LLM Gateway: Runtime Controls for Agents
items.en_oneliner: LangSmith LLM Gateway is now in public beta, giving production agents caps on spending, limits on rates, model fallbacks, and PII redaction — without tying them to one provider.
